comments.why: Adam Savage unboxes a 3D-printed Curta built by Marcus Wu.
comments.text: Marcus Wu designed, 3D-printed, and assembled a 3x scale working Curta calculator. He shared his models and progress on Thingverse at [LINK] His YouTube channel includes many videos of the development, assembly, and operation of his calculator. Watch a short demonstration at [LINK] Adam Savage commissioned Marcus to build a copy. Adam unboxes his 3D-printed Curta on YouTube at [VIDEO]
